bundles.question: As of 2026-10-04, what is the latest stable/production (non–pre-release, non-RC/beta) release version of the Python programming language, and what exact release date does the official Python documentation state? Please use the official Python “Downloads/Latest Release” page and/or the official release schedule/changelog pages to identify the version and confirm it is not a pre-release.
bundles.summary:
- **Latest stable/production Python release (as shown on the official Python docs): Python 3.14.8** [https://www.python.org/downloads/windows].
- **Official release date stated on the Python downloads page: Sept. 30, 2026** (listed as “Python 3.14.8 - Sept. 30, 2026” under stable releases) [https://www.python.org/downloads/windows].
- **Non-stable (pre-release) newer version indicator:** the official Python “Download” page lists **“3.15 pre-release … (planned) 2026-10-01”**, indicating that as of 2026-10-04 a newer version exists but is still a **pre-release**, so the latest stable remains 3.14.8 [https://www.python.org/downloads].
